title: com.docker.sandbox/volume@1
description: Config schema for one volume need: a persistent (or tmpfs) path and its characteristics. Instance-shaped, keyed by cleaned path. Matching configurations across Kits merge; differing configurations conflict. Storage belongs to the sandbox instance. The @1 in the type names this schema; it moves when the schema does.

path.description: Instance-local destination, compared after path cleaning.

size.description: Capacity request; suffixes use powers of 1024. Equivalent byte values match; omission or an empty string is unspecified and differs from an explicit value.

tmpfs.description: Private scratch storage, empty after stop or recreation. Omission is equivalent to false.

mode.description: Initial permissions, compared by octal value. Reattachment preserves existing permissions; omission or an empty string is unspecified.
